src = '''
from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    colorcount = Counter(v for _,_,v in cells)
    marker = colorcount.most_common(1)[0][0]
    tmpl = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in cells if v!=marker]
    rs=[r for r,_,_ in tmpl]; cs=[c for _,c,_ in tmpl]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    ar, ac = (r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2
    tmap = {(r-r0, c-c0): v for r,c,v in tmpl}
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if v!=marker: continue
        for (dr,dc),tv in tmap.items():
            nr, nc = r + (dr - (ar-r0)), c + (dc - (ac-c0))
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: out[nr][nc]=tv
    return out
'''
open('programs/task-f3ea9768.py','w').write(src)
